fact: The update reports that Morocco announced plans to officially unveil its National AI Roadmap, "Morocco AI 2030"; no adoption is stated. The event falls in January-February 2026; the document is published 2026-06-23.

fact: Digital Transition minister Amal El Fallah told parliament that a national strategic programme called 'AI Made in Morocco' is being drawn up on the conference's recommendations; no adoption is stated.
Decree 2-26-831 of 26 October 2026 charges minister Ahmed Rahhou with drawing up the government's AI policy and overseeing its implementation, per Médias24.

The digital transition and administrative reform minister told parliament's interior committee on 10 November 2026 that he was launching the 'Morocco AI 2030' roadmap, with three pillars and 10 structural programmes.
